Might of the Tribe is a decent cloak for Rogues, DPS Warriors, Hunters, Enhancement specced Shamans and moderate for Retribution specced Paladins.

Metzen the Reindeer is a neutral quest, that is only available during the Feast of Winter Veil. There are two versions of the quest, and both may be completed each year, although the locations of the quest givers in faction capitals would make it difficult for most to do so.
Midrealm Post is a very small settlement located in the southeastern part of Eco-Dome Midrealm. It is led by the Consortium, but also has a couple of goblin representatives from Area 52.
Michael is a level 30 stable master located outside the Theramore Isle inn of Dustwallow Marsh. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.

__NOTOC__ Miblon Snarltooth is gnoll guarding a nursery of Evoroot plants on the eastern outskirts of the Ruins of Ravenwind in Feralas. The nursery is blocked by a door, but players can use Bait (purchased from Gregan Brewspewer) to temporarily lure Miblon away and cause the door to vanish, allowing them to enter the building and loot the plant for the quest The Videre Elixir (2).
Metallic Fragments are quest items needed by the Horde for the quest Natural Materials.
Miall is a draenei artisan blacksmithing trainer located at the Trader's Tier in the Exodar. During the Battle for the Exodar, she was inside Velen's protective shield.
Miglik Blotstrom was a level 70 Arena battlemaster located in the Seat of the Naaru in the draenei capital of the Exodar.
Middenvale is a wooded area of southeastern Bloodmyst Isle. Its most notable feature is a pair of crashed escape pods from the Exodar. Treants, bears, and lashers roam the vale of corrupted trees.
__NOTOC__ Messenger Hermesius is a draenei located at Blood Watch in Bloodmyst Isle.
The Metallic Headband of Simm'onz is a quest reward from Forge Camp: Annihilated.
Messenger of Fate drops from Gurtogg Bloodboil in the Black Temple.

The Might of Kalimdor was a combined Alliance-Horde army raised through an unprecedented agreement between Regent Lord Bolvar and Warchief Thrall, as both factions would combine the might of their armies in response to the stirring of the qiraji who were locked behind the Scarab Wall in Silithus. Under the command of the orc Varok Saurfang, they were gathered at Cenarion Hold — in the center of the silithid hives that dominated the region — during the Ahn'Qiraj War. After Shiromar opened the Scarab Wall and the war ended, the members of the Might of Kalimdor splintered off to continue their duties in Outland and Northrend in the forms of the 7th Legion and the Kor'kron. Years later, stories
Messenger to Thrall sends the adventurer back to Azeroth to bring news of the untainted Outland orcs back to the Warchief.

Meta gems match meta sockets. These gems have special requirements that must be met for the gem's bonus to activate. For example, in order to gain the benefits of a Tireless Starflare Diamond there must be a minimum of one gem of each color between all the items currently equipped on the character. It should be noted that gems which match multiple socket colors can fulfil meta gem requirements for each and any color they match. For example, if a meta gem needs 3 red and 2 yellow to activate, then 3 orange (red/yellow) gems can activate this gem. Also, a gem does not have to match its socket to contribute to a meta gem; therefore the player may choose to lose an item's gem bonus in order to a
A meta gem is a gem that only fits in a meta gem socket. A meta gem socket only accepts a meta gem.
Middle Map Fragment is found inside a Pirate's Footlocker that drops from Southsea Pirates.

global premiere in June 2016]] Michael "Mike" Morhaime is the former strategic advisor and one of the co-founders of Blizzard Entertainment. Before October 3, 2018, he was the president, Chief Executive Officer for the company. Michael Sacco, also known as Belfaire, was a Blizzard employee who posted frequently on the US World of Warcraft [http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/board.html?sid=1&forumId=11112 Customer Service Forum]. His avatar is a Cobalt War Talbuk from the plains of Nagrand. He worked out of the Austin, Texas office. Belfaire is no longer a CSR of the Customer Service Forum, and has moved on to greener pastures. His last post on the official forums was made on September 29, 2008.
Midsummer Ground Flower is a firework item that darts around on the floor and crackles and throws out yellow sparks and shoots up into the air and EXPLODES! Wheeeee!
Metzen's Letters and Notes are contained in Smokywood Satchel.
Might of Kalimdor Archmages were humans of the Might of Kalimdor in Silithus during the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj event.
Might of Mograine is a death knight talent located on tier 9 of the Blood tree.

Midge is a gnome found in Valiant Rest of Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra. She stated being rescued by Wyrmrest Accord agents out of Amber Ledge from Malygos's forces. The fact that she was targeted in the first place points to her likely being a mage.
The Mid Point Station is in the western shadow of the Fizzcrank Pumping Station, in the middle of the Geyser Fields in the Borean Tundra.
The Metal Coffer can be found in the Ruins of Sha'naar in Hellfire Peninsula.
__NOTOC__ Midnight Ink is created with Inscription (75); taught by trainers.
Michael Schwan is an inscription trainer at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.
Meteorite Whetstone drops from King Ymiron in Utgarde Pinnacle.

Midsummer Reveler is a three item set that is worn in the chest, shoulder, and feet slots. These items are available for purchase for a total of 400 Burning Blossom from Midsummer Merchants and Midsummer Suppliers during the Midsummer Fire Festival event in capital cities. This set does not give any set bonus. However, the complete set must be equipped to be able to earn the achievement Burning Hot Pole Dance.

A meta-achievement is an achievement that only requires completion of other achievements. Meta-achievements typically reward more "points" than normal achievements, and occasionally reward the player with items or titles.
Mighty Rhino Dogs are created by Northrend Cooking (25); taught by Recipe: Mighty Rhino Dogs.
__NOTOC__ The Mighty Shadow Protection Potion is a fel potion that will protect the imbiber from all shadow related damage.

Michael Belfast was a chef in the unnamed inn found on the Road to Stratholme. He notices the adventurers that come out of the inn's cellar and yells them to get out. He also shouts at his patrons while tending to his fire. It's unknown what became of him. Ezra Grimm thinks Belfast should be arrested for the suspicious food they are eating.
The Mid Point Station Valve can be found in the Geyser Fields in the Borean Tundra.
__NOTOC__ A Mighty Alchemist Stone is an improved version of the Alchemist Stone, and as such fulfills the same requirement as a Philosopher's Stone for performing Transmutations.

Mickelob is a Blizzard employee who is also a non-official "Son" who corrects every text you see on SOTS.com with the proper spelling and grammar. It has been said that he is the "hidden ninja with elite, extra-sensory knowledge of writing, sound, Ghostbusters and prosciutto". He made an appearance at the 2007 San Diego Comic Con with Chris Metzen.

Messenger Torvus is an orc quest giver located at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight. He is a servant of High Overlord Saurfang. He approaches adventurers under the guise of discussing the war effort, when in reality he's there to clandestinely deliver a message regarding Garrosh Hellscream's rising prominence in the Horde.
Metok's Bubble Bock is the April brew from the Brew of the Month Club.
The Mightstone Quarry is the area surrounding Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra. It's currently overrun with undead nerubians.
Mezhen's Writings drop from Necro Overlord Mezhen at Gjalerbron in the Howling Fjord.
The Meteorite Crystal can be looted from the Gift of the Observer after defeating Algalon the Observer in the 10-man version of Ulduar.
Might of Dragonblight is a quest achievement earned for completing Dragonblight quests in Dragonblight
Midnight Sun can be looted after winning the Gunship Battle in the 10-man version of Icecrown Citadel.
Mighty Frostsaber was a frostsaber found near all starting areas on Azeroth. He could be found near the Night Elf Mohawk.

A group of two or more sub-guilds operating as a single guild. Meta-guilds share a common meta-guild name, officers and guild leaders -- and are primarily created due to Blizzard's UI limitation on guilds having no more than 500 members. Although it is technically possible to have over 500 players join a guild, at over 500 players the UI no longer shows all members online and has reduced operational functionality.
Messner's Cage Key is a quest item for Breaking Out is Hard to Do.

Mick Wingert is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.

The Might of the Forsaken is a quest reward from A New Life for Undeath.

__NOTOC__ Mestrah is a draenei located in Battle of Dazar'alor. She fights together with Manceroy Flamefist in order to stop the Horde champions. She fought and killed countless demons of the Burning Legion in the Twisting Nether. She calls herself the dragon of the Light.

Mezzamere is the base of the Waveblade Ankoan in Nazjatar, sitting on a rise in the Hanging Reef. Mezzamere is centered around a cluster of ancient kaldorei ruins. Since the waters around Nazjatar were parted during the Nazjatar Campaign, Mezzamere and the surrounding area have become dry land, and now accommodate a large Alliance presence, new allies of the ankoan.

Michul'mon appears to have been a Zandalari troll. His plaque can be found in the chamber where Reanimated Horrors cluttered the place; inside the Necropolis Catacombs in Nazmir.

Micah Wil'son is a Zandalari troll whose skull can be found at the Head Shop in Dazar'alor.
Micro-Vortex Generators are sold by Marcia Chase in Dalaran. This item is useful when fishing for The Wish Remover achievement.
Midnight Starpeppers are sold by food vendors in Ardenweald.

Meteoric Flare is an Azerite trait for Demonology warlocks. It doesn't appear to be available.
Mey is a tortollan located in northern Exile's Reach. He is found in a secret underwater cave under a waterfall.
Meticulously Pickled Heads are looted from Bonebound Chests in Maldraxxus.

Messenger's Satchels are looted from Stoneborn Satchels in Revendreth.
Messenger's Greaves are a quest reward from Time For Change.
Messenger's Vest is a quest reward from No Time for Goodbyes!.

The Meticulous Ledger is located in Tuul's tent in Haven in Zereth Mortis. It can only be read during Seeking the Unknown.
Miggsie is an abomination leftover located in Butchers Block in Maldraxxus.
__NOTOC__ Microlicid is a helicid companion crafted with Protoform Synthesis. The recipe is learned from Schematic: Microlicid.

The Midsummer Bonfires are located in multiple locations during the Midsummer Fire Festival. Players of both factions can complete the quest Honor the Flame at the bonfires. Mighty Hunter's Horn is used near a Shikaar Banner of Might.

Michel Martin Koiter (3 May 1984 – 18 March 2004) was one of Blizzard's premium artists. He was known under the name of "Twincruiser," an artistic collaboration with his twin brother René Koiter. He died at the age of 19 of unexpected heart failure.

Michael Barken was a voice actor in Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos.
Mind Vision is a channeled level 42 Discipline and Shadow priest utility spell. It allows the priest to see through the target's eyes for 1 minute.

Mind Soothe is a Priest spell that reduces the aggro radius of a target mob, allowing you to tactically avoid pulling certain enemies. This is very useful to skip certain pulls, or to run through certain areas without drawing enemies, and is thus comparable to a targeted version of stealth in some situations. Beware that if the mob resists Mind Soothe you will aggro it and enter combat. Using Mind Soothe on players of the enemy faction is an aggressive action and will cause guards of neutral cities to aggro.

Milstaff Stormeye is a gnome portal trainer located in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge.
Miner's Revenge is a quest reward from Oh Brother. . .. Though it was a mining pick for some time before its removal in retail, it cannot be used as one in Classic.

Mind Quickening Gem is a trinket for mages that can increase their casting speed. It drops from Vaelastrasz the Corrupt in Blackwing Lair.
Militias are civilians taking up arms to defend themselves. During the Third War, the Human Refugees contained many militiamen supported by remnants of the Alliance military.

Milli Featherwhistle is a gnome mechanostrider vendor located in Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. She actually builds her inventory herself. She was motivated by Gelbin Mekkatorque during the Operation: Gnomeregan. She was present during the Legion Invasions.
The Miners' League (or Miners' Union) is a group of dwarven miners. A Miners' Union Card is issued to prospectors who have skills in mining, and can be used to identify them.

Mikhail is a human quest giver located in Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Although he is apparently a bartender by the title above his head, he doesn't actually sell any drinks. He was an SI:7 operative.

Mindless Zombies are very weak zombies located north of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. Along with Wretched Zombies, they are main inhabitants of the deserted northern half of Deathknell. Shadow Priest Sarvis sends newly recruited Forsaken to cull their numbers.
Milli's Lexicon is a quest reward from Shards of the Felvine (Classic).
__NOTOC__ Mijan is a jungle troll ghost found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
Mindfire Waistband drops from Keli'dan the Breaker in the Blood Furnace wing of Hellfire Citadel.
Mine Spiders are venom spider mobs that can be found roaming the inner parts of Jasperlode Mine in Elwynn Forest.
Militia Warhammer is a quest reward from Blackrock Invasion.
Militia Shortsword is a quest reward from Blackrock Invasion.

Mind Mastery is a mage talent that increases spell damage by a percentage of the mage's intellect - 3% per rank up to 15% at max rank. This talent includes intellect from gear, buffs and other talents, such as Arcane Mind. For most high level mages, the amount of spell damage gained from this talent is significant.

Milling, a sub-skill of Inscription, is used to make pigments from herbs which can be obtained via the Herbalism skill. Five herbs of the same type are consumed per milling attempt and produce 1-4 pigments, with the most common result being a single pigment milled. Higher level herbs may also occasionally produce rarer pigments. Similar to Prospecting, the type of herbs that can be milled for pigments scales up with Inscription skill level. Beginning with herbs from Outland, high end herbs such as Mana Thistle, Lichbloom, and Twilight Jasmine have a much better yield of pigments then lower herbs like Felweed, Goldclover, and Cinderbloom.

Mimir's Workshop is a small workshop located west of Ulduar. It is a cavernous space, warmed by ever-burning fires, filled with anvils and a large store of metal bars. The outside and interior of the workshop are littered with bodies of mechagnomes. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard visited the workshop and mentioned the presence of several friendly mechagnomes, however, Keeper Mimiron himself was elsewhere.
